_meta.usage: the Latin letter before the number on a private plate (B 123456, Z 4567) or just the letter
_meta.note: The letter is the office where the car was registered, not where the photo was taken.
_meta.miss_note: A (pre-1998 numbers, no region), M (motorcycles, commercial, institutions), P (public transport), J, R, MP, C, D (judges, clergy, MPs, consular, diplomatic) carry no region

G.note: Jounieh office; the source lists it under Mount Lebanon, which held Keserwan before 2017

O.note: Ouzai office, southern suburbs of Beirut

K.note: Baalbek office; the source lists Beqaa (before Baalbek-Hermel was split off) and marks the letter 'not in use'
